ProjectUpsertRequest.description:
Payload for creating or updating projects.

Notes:
- `customer_id` is deprecated. Use `company_id`.
- `labels` is deprecated. Use `tags`.
- For retainer projects (`retainer=true`), business rules require
  `start_date`, `finish_date` and `budget_monthly`.
- For retainers, `start_date` must be the first day and `finish_date`
  the last day of a month.

fixed_price.description: Whether the project is fixed price.

retainer.description: Whether project is billed as retainer.

retainer_billing_title.description: Default title for generated retainer items.

retainer_billing_description.description: Default description for generated retainer items.

billing_variant.description:

currency.description: Project currency. Mandatory on create and immutable afterwards.

billing_notes.description: Notes printed or used during billing.

setting_include_time_report.description: Include time report in billing output.

skip_favorite.description: Do not add this project to favorites for the creator.

InvoiceCreateRequest.description:
Payload for creating a new invoice.

Business rules:
- `customer_id`, `recipient_address`, `date`, `due_date`, `title`, `currency` and `items` are always required.
- Either `vat_code_id` or `tax` (deprecated) must be provided. When both are given, `vat_code_id` takes precedence and `tax` is ignored.
- `service_period_from` and `service_period_to` are expected together when a service period is used.
- `status` defaults to backend behavior when omitted.
- `category` defaults to `default` when omitted. `partial` invoices cannot have a discount.
- Use `status=draft` to create a draft invoice.

status.description:
Initial invoice status. When omitted, the backend applies its default behavior.
Set to `draft` to create a draft invoice that is not yet issued and can be edited further.

category.description:
Invoice category. When omitted, defaults to `default`.
- `default`: Regular invoice.
- `partial`: Partial invoice (Abschlagsrechnung). Cannot be combined with a discount.
- `final`: Final invoice (Schlussrechnung).

service_period_from.description: Service period start. Use together with `service_period_to`.

service_period_to.description: Service period end. Use together with `service_period_from`.

salutation.description: Salutation text. Supports template variables such as `{salutation}`, `{recipient}`, `{company_name}`, `{date}`, `{due_date}`, and more.

footer.description: Footer text. Supports template variables such as `{identifier}`, `{gross_total}`, `{net_total}`, `{user}`, `{me}`, and more.

change_address.description: Replace recipient address from selected source.

tax.description: Deprecated. VAT/tax percentage. Use `vat_code_id` instead. When `vat_code_id` is provided, this field is ignored.

vat_code_id.description: VAT code ID for this invoice. Takes precedence over the deprecated `tax` field. Available VAT codes can be fetched via `GET /api/v1/vat_code_sales`.

print_detail_columns.description: Include detailed columns in print layouts.

custom_properties.description: Custom field values keyed by custom field name.

letter_paper_id.description: Letter paper ID to use for this invoice. When omitted, the account's default invoice letter paper is used. If `without_letter_paper` is set to `true`, this field is ignored. Available letter papers can be fetched via `GET /api/v1/letter_papers`.

without_letter_paper.description: When set to `true`, creates the invoice without letter paper (white). This takes precedence over `letter_paper_id`.

A planned purchase defines a budget for purchases with a specific supplier,
purchase budget, and user. It can be one-time or recurring (weekly, monthly, etc.).

net_total.description: Net total amount in the planned purchase currency.

exhausted.description: Amount already spent from planned purchase.

purchases.description: Linked purchases created from this planned purchase.

custom_properties.description: Custom property values for the planned purchase.

create_on_recur.description: Whether to automatically create purchases on recurrence.

Approval.description:
Approval entry for an invoice or purchase.

An approval tracks whether an invoice or purchase has been approved or denied
by a designated approver. The `target_type` field indicates whether the approval
belongs to an invoice or a purchase, and the `target` field contains the
corresponding invoice or purchase object.

target_type.description: The type of the approval target.

decided_at.description: Timestamp when the approval decision was made.

note.description: Note attached to the approval request.

deny_note.description: Note attached when denying the approval.

processed_by.description: User who approved or denied the approval request.

target.description: The invoice or purchase this approval belongs to.

target_type.description: The type of the approval target.

target_id.description: ID of the invoice or purchase to approve.

approver_id.description: ID of the first user assigned to approve.

approver2_id.description: ID of an optional second approver.

note.description: Optional note attached to the approval request.

budget_relevant.description: Whether this expense affects budget calculations.

billable.description: Whether this expense can be billed to customer.

billed.description: Whether this expense has already been billed.
